result.description: LEADCON TECH PTY LTD   Role Summary   Leadcon Tech Pty Ltd is seeking a seasoned SAP Supply Chain Professional with over 10 years of experience in end-to-end SAP ECC and S/4HANA implementations, global rollouts, and Center of Excellence (CoE) roles. The ideal candidate has deep expertise in SAP MM, WM, and Procurement, with strong cross-module integration across SD, PP, PM, FICO, PS, and MDG. Experience in Oil & Gas, Energy, or large-scale industrial sectors is highly valued.   Benefits   Task & responsibilities   Key Responsibilities    Lead end-to-end SAP S/4HANA implementation and migration projects for procurement, inventory, and warehouse management.  Work with users to formulate and document business requirements, and translate them into functional system specifications.  Identify, investigate, and analyze business processes, procedures, and work practices to recommend optimal system solutions.  Identify inefficiencies and recommend improvements in system functionality, behavior, and business practices.  Develop project plans, cost estimates, and resource allocation using project management methodologies.  Take responsibility for deploying functional solutions, including creating system test plans to ensure quality and integrity.  Create user and training documentation, and conduct formal training classes for end users and key stakeholders.  Develop functional specifications for use by system developers and technical teams.  Use data and process modeling techniques to create clear system specifications for design and development.  Act as a central reference and information source, providing guidance in system project decision-making.  Manage integration with third-party tools such as Jagger (eProcurement), IBP, MDG, SharePoint, and barcoding systems.  Embed compliance frameworks (e.g., Manual of Authority) into procurement workflows.  Lead change requests, system enhancements, and continuous improvement roadmaps.    Key Skills    Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities  Excellent written and verbal communication skills  Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities  Proficiency in data and process modeling techniques  Experience with project management methodologies (SCRUM, Kaizen)  Attention to detail and a proactive, solution-oriented approach  Deep SAP S/4HANA Procurement and MM configuration skills  Cross-module integration expertise  User training, documentation, and workshop facilitation    Qualification & experience   Qualifications & Experience    Qualifications:   Bachelor's degree in Computer Software Engineering or related field. SAP S/4HANA Procurement and SAP MM and Ariba certifications are strongly preferred.   Experience:    10+ years in SAP MM, WM, and Supply Chain roles  Minimum 5+ years in S/4HANA implementations and upgrades  Proven experience in Oil & Gas, Energy, or large industrial sectors  Experience leading global template rollouts and cross-functional teams    Language Requirement:   Fluent in English (written and spoken)  About Company    Leadcon Tech Pty Ltd is an Australian proprietary company limited by shares, registered with the Australian Securities and Investments Commission (ACN 664 795 902) in New South Wales since January 2023. Headquartered at Spring Farm, NSW, the company operates under the leadership of its director, Rakesh Kumar. As a growing enterprise in the technology space, Leadcon Tech Pty Ltd is committed to building strong operational foundations and expanding its capabilities to meet evolving industry demands.
